# planish

> In-app feedback for Flutter: users share bugs, ideas and questions from
> the app, and each report carries an annotated screenshot, a log timeline,
> device context and state snapshots. Sent by email or to your own API.
> Nothing leaves the device without the user pressing Send. No third-party
> service.

Use it next to a crash reporter, not instead of one. Android and iOS.
Minimum Flutter 3.32 / Dart 3.8; check `pubspec.yaml` for the installed
version's constraints.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/kindware-dev/planish/blob/main/README.md): every
  option, the privacy table, theming, localization, working with other
  packages.
- [Agent integration guide](https://github.com/kindware-dev/planish/blob/main/doc/agent-integration.md):
  for AI coding agents integrating the package into an existing app. Working
  rules, questions to ask the human, ordered steps, checks, things not to do.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/kindware-dev/planish/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md):
  breaking changes and renames between versions.
- [Example app](https://github.com/kindware-dev/planish/tree/main/example/lib):
  senders, log sinks, debug plugins, report context.

## Key concepts

- `Planish.init(PlanishConfig(...))` once, before `runApp`; `Planish.builder()`
  on the app; `Planish.navigationObserver` on the navigator or router.
- `Log.*` is the timeline: application logs, screen changes, HTTP calls made
  through `LoggingHttpClient`, lifecycle changes, uncaught errors.
- `reportContext` providers snapshot the app's state at report time;
  `analysisNotes` is a fixed text for whoever reads the report.
- Reports: `FeedbackReport` with `toJson()` and `toMarkdown()` (a brief);
  `requests` lists the HTTP calls around the error with their request and
  trace ids (`PrivacyConfig.traceHeaders` adds header names);
  senders `EmailFeedbackSender`, `HttpFeedbackSender`, `CallbackFeedbackSender`.
- `PrivacyConfig`: conservative defaults, redaction, `beforeSend`, a "What
  will be sent?" page for the user.
- Drafts: a report closed unsent is kept on the device with the context of
  when the form opened (`keepDrafts`, `Planish.drafts`).
- `prompts: PromptMode.off | quiet | notify`: after an uncaught error, a draft
  is prepared and, in `notify`, a card offers it (`promptFeedbackOnError` is
  deprecated).
